realName.dialogTitle: How we protect your real name
realName.dialogSubtitle: How we keep your information safe and your activity on the platform anonymous
realName.dialogWhyTitle: Why do we ask for your real name?
realName.dialogWhyBody: Some challenges collect real-name information for identity verification, judging and award ceremonies. We collect only the school-related details we need, and your activity on the platform stays anonymous.
realName.dialogAnonymousBody: Your everyday activity on the platform stays anonymous; other users cannot see your real identity
realName.dialogEncryptedBody: Your details are protected with industry-standard encryption against unauthorized access
realName.dialogPurposeBody: Your real name is used only where a challenge needs it to sign up, and for nothing else
realName.dialogIsolationBody: Your real name is held strictly apart from your platform account, so the two cannot be linked
realName.dialogFooter: Our systems protect your information in layers, so the few challenges that need a real name can get one while your privacy on the platform stays intact. Every access to your information is logged, and you can review those records at any time.

install.title: Install on your phone
install.intro: On your home screen, Cheese is a standalone app: its own icon, no address bar, and pages you have already read open offline.
install.installed: This device already has it — you are using Cheese as an app right now.
install.resultAccepted: Handed off to the system installer; Cheese will show up on your home screen shortly.
install.resultDismissed: Cancelled this time. The steps below work whenever you want to install.
install.resultNoPrompt: This browser did not offer an install prompt this time. Use the steps below to install by hand.
install.stepsTitleOther: Install it yourself from the browser menu:
install.iosStepOpen: Open this page in {browser} — the browser built into other apps has no “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStepShare: Tap the share button in the middle of the bottom bar.
install.iosStepAdd: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then tap “Add” in the top right.
install.otherStepOpen: Open this page in {browser} — on a Samsung phone, Samsung Internet works too.
install.otherStepInstall: Choose “Install app” — some versions call it “Add to Home Screen”.
install.desktopNote: The same works on a computer: Chrome puts an install icon with a down arrow at the right of the address bar.
install.warningTitle: Install with Chrome, not with “Add to desktop”
install.warningBody: Most browsers that only offer “Add to desktop” — the ones common in China among them — install a shell around the web page rather than the app: no file picker inside it (so you cannot send images or upload files) and no push notifications. Chrome installs the real app.

accessLogs.title: Real-name access log
accessLogs.intro: Every look at your real-name info appears here: who looked, when, and for what. We log each one so this page stays complete.
accessLogs.emptyHint: No one has viewed your real-name info
accessLogs.noticeTitle: About access to your real-name info
accessLogs.noticeBody: Access to your real-name info is tightly restricted: only designated staff can view it, and only for specific purposes such as contest verification or award review. Every view is logged and shown on this page. If you see a record you do not recognise, {contact} immediately.
